deployment_scope: isolated regtest/lab only; not intended for mainnet deployment

vectors.precondition: vanilla regtest baseline and experiment-off run use the same pinned Bitcoin Core source identity
vectors.action: compare normalized observable baseline fields after experiment-off execution

vectors.precondition: research harness state is reconstructible from explicit lab inputs
vectors.action: restart the harness without changing upstream Bitcoin Core state semantics

vectors.precondition: two lab evidence records have distinct declared context identities
vectors.action: attempt to validate evidence under the wrong context identity

vectors.precondition: a future experiment requests authorization migration behavior
vectors.action: inspect whether the requested behavior requires a high-impact Bitcoin decision
vectors.expected: stop at explicit decision gate before implementation
